checked_routes.result: The original Nico Nico video endpoint could not be read in the research browser. No exact cast/member identity evidence was obtained.

A publicly indexed republication of the original voice-drama video was readable, but the page description only says there were about 43 contributors and does not name the packet identities or establish the channel as the rights-holder authority.

The official Touhou guidance classifies fan-made video posting as derivative fan activity and discusses third-party IP permissions; it does not identify these Cookie☆ cast/persona names or map them to the official Touhou characters.

notes: Cookie☆ is a broad derivative-media ecosystem with mixed work/persona identities. These routes establish no safe direct HOME mapping for the ten current packet keys; no wiki, community roster, or Touhou character identity was promoted to evidence. Partial progress only, not a negative or terminal conclusion.
